title: Smooth purity over an arbitrary finite coefficient ring
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ and a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a smooth separated $k$-morphism of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $n\geq1$ and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $\ell^nA=0$. Use ordinary, uncompleted constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Here $\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ means bounded complexes with intrinsically constructible cohomology [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] and finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]; $Rf_{!,A}\dashv f_A^!$ is the constructible adjunction of [sk-prop-sf-existence, sk-prop-sf-rf-shriek-preservation]. Write $(-)_A=-\otimes_R^LA$ for scalar extension from $R=\mathbf Z/\ell^n$ [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor]. The Tate line $A_T(r)$ is the inverse image from the ordinary etale site of $\mu_{\ell^n,T}\otimes_R A_T$ for $r=1$, its tensor powers for $r>0$, $A_T$ for $r=0$, and the dual of $A_T(-r)$ for $r<0$; these are the canonical exponent-independent twists of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], with $K(r)=K\otimes_A^LA_T(r)$. The tensor map in clause (3) means the adjoint transpose of the inverse compact-support projection formula followed by $1_K\otimes\varepsilon_{A_Y}$. At $R$ the orientation of [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object] is applied with $E=\mathbf Q_\ell$ and level $n$, with the vector-bundle arrow in that diagonal construction given by the inverse of the integration-transposed comparison of [thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity]. Then:

1. the relative dualizing complex $\omega_{f,A}=f_A^!A_Y$ has an orientation
   $\omega_{f,A}\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X(d)[2d]$, namely the composite
   $$
   \omega_{f,A}=f_A^!\bigl(((\mathbf Z/\ell^n)_Y)_A\bigr)
   \xleftarrow[\ \sim\ ]{\ c_{\mathbf Z/\ell^n,A}\ }(\omega_{f,\mathbf Z/\ell^n})_A
   \xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\bigl((\mathbf Z/\ell^n)_X(d)[2d]\bigr)_A=A_X(d)[2d],
   $$
   where the last map is the extension of scalars of the orientation of
   [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object] and $c_{\mathbf Z/\ell^n,A}$ is the
   coefficient comparison of [det-sp-reduction-exceptional];
2. it agrees with the orientation obtained by running the diagonal and
   deformation construction directly with $A$-coefficients;
3. for every $K\in\Dctf(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},A)$ the composite
   $$
   \gamma_{f,A}(K):\ f_A^*K(d)[2d]\simeq f_A^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_X}A_X(d)[2d]
   \xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }f_A^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_X}\omega_{f,A}
   \xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }f_A^!K
   $$
   of the inverse orientation and the tensor map is an isomorphism, natural
   in $K$, and it does not depend on the choice of $n$.

proof.text: Derive compactness and Noetherianity of X and Y from finite type over D.k, then quasi-compactness and compactifiability of f. Apply lem-sp-general-ring-orientation at that fixed compactification. Define theta as the inverse canonical dualizing-unit comparison followed by comparison of alpha. Its scalar equation is the supplied orientation equation; its unit equation is the inverse identity.

Apply lem-pur-finite-general-ring-tensor-formula at N=ell^n and the supplied ordinary orientation. The exponent is a unit at every stalk because its global-section value is a unit over the finite field. This proves the tensor clause.

Apply lem-sp-general-ring-exponent to alpha. Equality alpha followed by b inverse = alpha prime followed by b prime inverse implies equality of the inverse isomorphisms b followed by alpha inverse. Regard sourceToOrigin as the component of a natural transformation in the ordinary line, built from the actual inverse origin counit, sitePullbackIso and the derived tensor comparison. Its naturality moves each common-level line map through sourceToOrigin. Expanding proGamma then leaves comparison of tensoring b followed by alpha inverse and the same smooth tensor mate. The inverse-orientation equality therefore proves equality of the full purity maps, even before restricting to Dctf. Package the witnesses with the two Kummer normalizations and direct orientation normalization.

proof_origin.place: Proof (1)-(3), orientation/tensor/exponent decomposition and explicit natural tensor assembly
